senses.gloss:
प्रैष m. (-षः)
 1. Sorrow, distress, affliction.
 2. Pain, suffering.
 3. Send-
ing, directing.
 4. Phrenzy, intoxication, insanity.
 E. प्र before, इष्
to go, aff. घञ् also प्रेष ।

प्रैष्य m. (-ष्यः) A servant, a slave.
 n. (-ष्यं) Service, servitude.
 E. प्र before,
इष् to go, and ण्यत् aff.
